title: rollout-conductor-introduce-contract-lanes-and-playbooked-rollback
author: Maya K. Singh
description: Motivation: Multiple teams have been extending canary and shadow runtimes with ad-hoc safety checks and manual rollback runbooks, which leads to inconsistent behavior across Dedicated and Private deployments. This PR introduces a rollout conductor that formalizes 'contract lanes' - named SLO/contract driven lanes that encode metric gates, degradation policy, and automated playbooked rollback steps. The goal is to provide a single declarative place to define lifecycle behavior for canary/A-B/shadow experiments, allow per-customer overrides in Dedicated, and enable safe automated rollback with human-in-loop confirmation when required. What this changes: 1) a new CRD schema for RolloutContract and ContractLane (helm/templates/rollout-contract-crd.yaml), 2) a conductor service that evaluates lane gates against streaming metrics and traces and emits actions (services/rollout/conductor.go, runtimes/scheduler/slo_evaluator.py), 3) a compact domain-specific contract language for expressing latency, error, and quality gates (docs/contracts.md, services/rollout/contract_parser.go), 4) a set of curated playbook templates that the conductor can execute for automated rollback, canary hold, or graceful drain (ops/playbooks/rollback/*), 5) console UX to create/edit contract lanes and visualize active guard state (console/src/components/rollout/ContractLaneEditor.tsx), 6) tests and end-to-end harness that run a staged canary against a local metrics emulator. Backwards compatibility: existing simple canaries still function; the conductor is opt-in via a RolloutContract reference on the service annotation. Rollout plan: merge to main behind feature flag rollout.conductor.enabled, deploy conductor to staging, exercise with synthetic traffic, and then flip flag for a small cohort of customers before global rollout. Testing: unit tests for parser and evaluator, integration test harness simulating metric regressions, manual runbook rehearsals with SRE. Risks and mitigations: initial gate thresholds may be too strict; we provide staged defaults and an automated 'relax' recommendation tool in Optimize. Implementation notes: the conductor uses streaming windowed aggregations to avoid double-counting and supports both absolute and relative thresholds. See related work and Linear tickets in linked_linear. Checklist: [x] design doc referenced, [x] CRD and Helm changes, [x] evaluator implementation, [x] playbooks added, [x] console editor, [x] unit/integration tests, [x] docs updated.
commits: 5 commits: 1) add RolloutContract CRD and helm templates; 2) implement contract parser and lane DSL; 3) conductor core evaluation loop and action emitter with mock metrics backend; 4) console editor and UX wiring; 5) add playbooks and integration tests + docs. Each commit includes focused unit tests and small fixtures.
review_discussion: Ethan: Please clarify how the conductor prevents cascading rollbacks when multiple services fail concurrently. Maya: The conductor emits idempotent actions and records per-service action state in the rollout journal; we added a circuit breaker to limit concurrent rollback ops per-region. Priya: The CRD surface looks large; can we split the API between policy and runtime fields? Author: Split done, policy fields are declarative and runtime fields are managed by the controller. Jonah: CI initially failed lint on console TSX; author fixed by extracting helpers. After fixes reviewers gave approvals. Final CI run passed. Post-merge: SRE will run a runbook rehearsal and we scheduled a postmortem slot if any regressions occur.
ci_logs_summary: Initial CI run: lint error in console component (TSX) and one flaky integration test. Fixes pushed, second run: all unit tests and lint passed, integration suite passed on rerun. End-to-end staging smoke tests green.
release_notes: Add RolloutContract CRD and rollout conductor service to enable contract-driven canaries and automated rollback playbooks.
Opt-in feature behind rollout.conductor.enabled flag. Requires Helm upgrade to include new CRD.
Console UX for creating and monitoring Contract Lanes.
Provides curated rollback and hold playbooks; SRE runbook rehearsals recommended before enabling for production.
post_merge_actions: Create Linear follow-ups for rollout observability dashboards (ENG-3520) and per-customer default contract templates (ENG-3531). Notify platform customers about opt-in flag and schedule two-week pilot. Add conductor metrics to SLO dashboards and alerts. Run SRE rehearsal within 7 days.
notes_for_ops: When enabling the feature, set rollout.conductor.max_concurrent_rollbacks to 2 in Dedicated clusters to avoid correlated rollbacks. Use ops/playbooks/rollback/graceful_drain_and-fallback.md for manual intervention. The conductor exposes /v1/status for health checks and /v1/action-log for audit trails.
qa_summary: Unit test coverage added for parser and evaluator. Integration harness runs staged canary with metric regression injection; expected behavior verified: lane gate trips -> conductor holds canary -> executes graceful drain playbook -> can optionally auto-rollback to checkpoint. Manual SRE runbook passed in simulated region partition scenario.
author_notes: This is intentionally opt-in to reduce blast radius. If we observe excessive false positives during pilot we will roll back the feature flag and relax the default thresholds. The contract DSL is intentionally small to keep policies auditable.
